text.description_html:
First Impressions AP-ATC150SBR, Large Acrylic Appliance Door Pull

The Arctic Appliance Door Pull from First Impressions is packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator / appliance door panel. The acrylic is manufacture with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. Available in your choice of Frosted or Crystal Clear Acrylic.

This long lasting acrylic appliance handle with a very clean contemporary design. The large 1-1/2" diameter pull handle makes it easy to open todays large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the ones found on a Sub Zero refrigerator.

Features and Specifications of the First Impressions Arctic Series Acrylic Appliance Pull:

  • Pull Handle Material: Clear or Frosted Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.
  • First Impressions Arctic Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Available in 3 Sizes:

    AP-ATC150018SBR:
    • Total Length: 18"
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Bracket Diameter: 2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/8"
    • Pull Clearance: 1-5/8"

    AP-ATC150024SBR:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 16"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Bracket Diameter: 2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/8"
    • Pull Clearance: 1-5/8"

    AP-ATC150036SBR:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 28"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Bracket Diameter: 2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/8"
    • Pull Clearance: 1-5/8"
